essentialIdeas: The cell membrane is selective, so some substances cross more easily than others.

activities.label: Cell membrane overview
activities.title: Selective barrier at the membrane
activities.body: Read the model and note the main rule. Then get ready to explain it back.

essentialIdeas: The cell membrane is selective, so some substances cross more easily than others.

activities.label: Explain the membrane rule
activities.title: Explain the membrane rule
activities.body: In one or two sentences, say what the membrane does. Use your own words.
activities.concept: Cell membrane as a selective barrier
activities.correctAnswer: The cell membrane is selective, so some substances cross it more easily than others.
activities.feedback: A complete answer says the membrane does not let everything pass equally and states that some substances cross more easily than others.

activities.label: Water movement across membrane
activities.title: Correct the water movement rule
activities.body: Fix the relationship between water and the membrane in one clear sentence.
activities.misconceptionSummary: Saying osmosis is water moving anywhere across a cell membrane without any net direction or concentration difference.
activities.correctAnswer: Osmosis is the net movement of water across a selective membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.
activities.feedback: The repair needs net movement and the direction from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.

activities.label: Explain osmosis again
activities.title: Explain osmosis again
activities.body: Now explain osmosis from memory in one or two sentences. Keep it plain and specific.
activities.correctAnswer: Osmosis is the net movement of water across a selective membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.
activities.feedback: A complete response names water, the selective membrane, net movement, and the direction of movement.

activities.label: Check the best description
activities.title: Which statement matches osmosis?
choices: Water moves across a selective membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.
All substances cross the membrane at the same rate.
Water moves only when the cell uses energy.
Water cannot cross a cell membrane.
activities.correctAnswer: Water moves across a selective membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.
activities.feedback: Osmosis is the net movement of water across a selective membrane, not equal movement of all substances or an energy-powered process.

items.essentialIdea: The cell membrane is selectively permeable, so some substances cross more easily than others.

check.title: Membrane passage
check.prompt: How does the cell membrane control what enters and leaves the cell?
check.referenceAnswer: It lets some substances cross more easily than others and slows or blocks many others.
check.feedback: Selective permeability means passage is unequal, not open to everything.

items.essentialIdea: Osmosis is the net movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.

check.title: Water movement in osmosis
check.prompt: What is osmosis, and in which direction does water move?
check.referenceAnswer: Osmosis is the net movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.
check.feedback: The key ideas are net movement, water, and the higher-to-lower water concentration direction.

recognitionCheck.title: Osmosis direction
choices: The net movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.
The net movement of salt across a membrane from lower water concentration to higher water concentration.
The movement of all substances equally across any membrane.
The movement of water from lower water concentration to higher water concentration.
recognitionCheck.correctAnswer: The net movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.
recognitionCheck.feedback: Osmosis is about water moving down its concentration difference through a selectively permeable membrane.
